cleaned_entries.title: Full-stack FastAPI + Streamlit + PostgreSQL Compose
cleaned_entries.content:
Full-stack FastAPI + Streamlit + PostgreSQL Compose

Compose pattern for a three-service stack: FastAPI backend (port 8000) receiving DATABASE_URL and GROQ_API_KEY, Streamlit frontend (port 8501) depending on backend, and PostgreSQL 15 database. Frontend overrides CMD to run streamlit. All credentials supplied via environment variables.

Decision rules:
- Use for full-stack Python applications with Streamlit UI, FastAPI API, and PostgreSQL
- Frontend depends_on backend — Compose starts backend service first
- Pass GROQ_API_KEY and other third-party API keys only via .env or Docker secrets

Trade-offs:
- No persistent volume for database — add a named volume under volumes: for data durability
- No readiness healthchecks — services may connect before dependencies finish initializing

Anti-patterns:
- Do not hardcode API keys (e.g. GROQ_API_KEY) inline in docker-compose.yml
- Do not expose all internal service ports to the host unnecessarily
